messages:
anya: Heads-up — midnight change window for eu-west has a pinned deploy in the queue that looks inconsistent. Deploy is for release v2.14.0 but rwinf-eu-3 is still pinned to v2.13.7. Anyone on call?

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: release=v2.14.0 target=eu-west window=2026-04-03T00:00Z canary=50% status=queued
Conflicting pin detected on host: rwinf-eu-3 tag=v2.13.7

matt: I can take this. Recommend we hold the window for ~30m to reconcile pins and run a quick smoke. If we can't fix host tag, set canary=0 and abort to avoid partial rollout. :thumbsup:

ops-oncall: Confirming rollback playbook is ready. Quick ops runbook: 1) pause canary 2) scale down new tasks 3) revert traffic to previous revision 4) trigger alerting runbook. I'll be watching metrics and on pager if anything spikes. Contact +1-555-0133 if needed.

sylvia: Release notes: https://redwood-inference/internal/releases/v2.14.0 — highlights: batching perf improvements, kv-cache bugfix. Looks like rwinf-eu-3 missed the automated pin update; tagging hook likely failed. I'll add a note to the changelog.

jordan: I can patch the host manually. SSH to rwinf-eu-3 and run:
```
sudo docker pull redwood/inference:v2.14.0 && sudo docker tag redwood/inference:v2.14.0 redwood/inference:current && sudo systemctl restart inference
```
I'll take it if someone gives ack. :hammer_and_wrench:

anya: @jordan go for it. @matt please set deploy-bot to hold for now. We don't want the deploy to proceed during manual fix.

deploy-bot: Action: hold applied by matt. Deploy paused for thread 1762003456. To resume: `deploy-bot resume 1762003456`.

matt: Holding until 00:30Z. If jordan confirms the tag swap succeeds, we'll resume with a 10% canary first, monitor for 10m, then ramp to 50%. If any error-rate >1% we abort and roll back.

ops-oncall: I'll watch latency and error-rate dashboards and set a 5m alert threshold for error-rate >1%. Logging hooks primed.

sylvia: Added checklist item: run `rg-tag-check --region eu-west` as final pre-deploy gate to ensure no hosts are mistakenly pinned. Also updated the rollout notes with the manual-fix steps.

jordan: Patching now, will report back in ~3m.

jordan: Done — tag updated and service restarted on rwinf-eu-3. Health checks returned green. :white_check_mark:

matt: Nice. I'll trigger a 10% canary now then monitor.

deploy-bot: Action: canary set to 10% for thread 1762003456. Canary started.

ops-oncall: Canary metrics look stable for first 5m. No error-rate increase, latency steady.

matt: Proceeding to 50% as planned.

deploy-bot: Action: canary ramp to 50% for thread 1762003456.

anya: Thanks team — keeping the window but glad we held until pins were reconciled. Closing the loop here; I've noted the automation failure for follow-up. :eyes:
